name: 2018-10-29 - City PFOS Exceedance Email and TestAmerica Leachate Package.pdf
description: Complete 42-page October 29, 2018 City email, TestAmerica job 190-17646-1 and DEQ IPP PFAS screening guidance package. The primary October 3 leachate sample reports PFOS 120 ng/L, PFOA 590 ng/L, PFHxS 610 ng/L, PFBS 950 ng/L, PFHxA 2,100 ng/L, PFPeA 610 ng/L and PFPeS 160 ng/L; a duplicate leachate sample and equipment, field and method blanks are included. Cadillac's laboratory supervisor wrote that the leachate results exceeded the applicable 12 ng/L PFOS water-quality standard. Utilities Director Jeff Dietlin asked DEQ whether PFAS was making it through the plant and stated that the trucked-in leachate could be stopped at any time. The package documents contemporaneous knowledge and stated operational control; it does not establish that acceptance actually stopped, identify a final delivery date or answer whether PFAS passed through the WWTP.
